metadata.title: Vietoris-Rips complexes of affine Coxeter groups
metadata.abstract: We prove that all affine Coxeter groups admit contractible Vietoris-Rips complexes. More precisely, for any affine Coxeter group $W_a$ there exists a finite generating set $A$ such that $\mathcal{VR}_t(W_a;A)$ is contractible for all $t\ge 1$. We prove this as a special case of a more general result about certain groups. Let $G$ be a group and $H$ a subgroup. A subgroup $F\le G$ is a supplement of $H$ in $G$ if $G=HF$. We prove that for $H\le G$ with $F$ a supplement of $H$ in $G$, for generating sets $A_H$ and $A_G$ of $H$ and $G$ satisfying certain conditions involving $F$, the Vietoris-Rips complexes $\mathcal{VR}_t(G;A_G)$ and $\mathcal{VR}_t(H;A_H)$ are homotopy equivalent for all $t\ge 1$. In particular this applies to affine Coxeter groups, since free abelian groups admit contractible Vietoris-Rips complexes. Beyond these general results, we also investigate affine Coxeter groups $W_a$ specifically using the standard generating set $S$, and prove contractibility of $\mathcal{VR}_t(W_a;S)$ for large enough $t$.

analysis.workSummary: 作者证明每个仿射Coxeter群可选择有限生成集A，使其Vietoris–Rips复形在所有t≥1时可缩；对标准生成集S则证明充分大t时可缩。一般工具是当子群H及其supplement满足相应生成集条件时，G与H的Rips复形对t≥1同伦等价。
techniques: 仿射Coxeter群及自由阿贝尔子群
analysis.breakthrough: 通过合适生成集把仿射群的离散尺度拓扑降到自由阿贝尔模型，并另处理自然标准生成集的大尺度范围。
analysis.limitations: 所有t≥1的结论依赖特选生成集；对标准生成集只保证充分大尺度。一般supplement定理还有生成集兼容条件，不能省略。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
